description:
**Trim Removal Tools Set (3D Printable)**

This is a set of 3D printable trim removal tools designed for safely removing car interior panels, clips, and trim pieces without damaging surfaces.

The set includes multiple tool shapes:

- Straight and narrow tools for tight spaces
- Curved tools for better leverage
- Fork-style tools for clip removal
- A wide spatula for gentle panel separation

**Features:**

- Safe for plastic surfaces (especially when printed in PLA or PETG)
- Lightweight and easy to handle
- Customizable and easy to reprint
- Useful not only for cars, but also for electronics and household repairs

**Print Settings:**

- Material: PETG recommended (PLA also works)
- Infill: 30–50%
- Walls/Perimeters: 3–4
- Orientation: print flat for better strength

If you find this model useful, feel free to leave a like 👍
